steps.name: Preparar
steps.task: Read the Paper guides the skill names, the canvas information and the font families.

steps.name: Brief
steps.task: Propose the brief: mood candidates, chosen mood, palette, type scale and direction.

steps.name: Aprovação do brief
steps.task: Wait for the user to approve the brief before drawing anything. Quote the user's exact words in "userWords". Never infer a yes.

steps.name: Mobile
steps.task: Build the mobile artboard (390 x 844) one visual group at a time, and check it with a screenshot.

steps.name: Desktop
steps.task: Adapt the approved mobile design to desktop (1440 x 900) and check it with a screenshot.

steps.name: Terminar
steps.task: Finish working on the nodes and explain the design decisions.
